assessment: Source and active-identification closure pass for the focused family. The runtime expression is exactly the source Lorentzian L3 with common A3=1.5 and private omega03/sigma3 values from the two selected Table 1 rows. Independent direct evaluation agrees with the WorldModel at all three permitted energies with zero observed floating-point discrepancy. The two diagnostic energies are 528.0 and 529.4 eV; 528.5 eV is held out and disjoint. The episode budget is two, so Discovery cannot enumerate the three-point domain. Identification exposes two scalar slots, sigma3 and omega03. The 2-by-2 diagnostic Jacobian has nonzero determinant -0.1915280486254431 historically and -0.035556529700303485 in the pumped branch, hence local rank two in both worlds. Public definitions are identical across world twins apart from the opaque instance ID; state identity and numerical center/linewidth remain private. Known-truth Identification and Discovery submissions pass both worlds, false-twin submissions fail, and CaseOracle evidence is track-invariant and repeatable.
